user.title: DoorConnect v3 door station
user.description: IP address of the outdoor station (WelcomeEye Connect 3) and its 6-digit device code (the one the DoorConnect app asks for).

cloud.title: History (optional)
cloud.description: The unlock/call log only exists in the app's cloud. Enter the email and password of the DoorConnect account that owns the device, or leave empty to skip history. Warning: the account locks after several wrong passwords.

reauth_confirm.title: DoorConnect account rejected
reauth_confirm.description: The cloud rejected the credentials. Please enter them again.

error.cannot_connect: Device unreachable (or wrong code: the device then stalls its answer).
error.invalid_cloud_auth: Account credentials rejected by the cloud.
